Priya (CS Ops): Hey team — seeing a gap between playbook webhook fires and CRM healthscore updates. Some accounts got two onboarding nudges within an hour. sample trace: https://our-telemetry/ui/trace/abc123

Jon (Integrations): ugh. can you paste the webhook payload?

Priya (CS Ops): payload snippet:
```
{ "event": "playbook_fired", "playbook_id": "pb_onboard_3", "account_id": 12345, "timestamp": 1749876520 }
```

Sam (Eng-Observability): looks like ingestion lag. our queue shows retries ~1749876560-1749876600. maybe a transient spike during batch rollout.

Ava (CS Manager): double-nudges -> customer annoyance. we should gate on healthscore change + dedupe window.

Jon (Integrations): agree. propose: idempotency_key = playbook_id + account_id + calendar_day; drop duplicates within 24h. also add a short backoff if healthscore write is pending.

Priya (CS Ops): also seeing missing healthscore writes — playbook fires before healthscore calc completes. options: 1) delay playbook trigger until scoring job finishes, 2) add a post-fire healthscore sync job that patches missing writes.

Sam (Eng-Observability): quick mitigation: a) playbook-runner adds a 2s jitter + check for recent healthscore write b) enqueue downstream job to re-run healthscore write if not present. i'll open RFC and a task.

playbook-bot: Created task PB-4421 to add dedupe + healthsync. https://redwood/tasks/PB-4421

Ava (CS Manager): thx. Priya can you gather ~10 sample accounts hit by the double-nudge and attach to PB-4421? @Priya

Priya (CS Ops): sure — will add samples and quick repro steps by EOD. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng-Observability): i'll also add a temporary dashboard: playbook->health delay (p50/p95) and an alert if > 5m.

Priya (CS Ops): FYI telemetry shows ~2% overlap during peak onboarding waves.

Ava (CS Manager): good — let's aim to reduce to <0.2% before next major rollout. will track in the PM cadence.

Priya (CS Ops): ack. i'll update PB-4421 with timeline and sample list.
